assignment.algorithm: deduplicate validation courier_id; sort by (SHA256(b'india-eta-val-role-v1|20261029|' + courier_id UTF-8) digest bytes, courier_id); first floor(N/3) groups fusion_calibration, remainder model_selection
assignment.counts_are_by: unique courier groups; record counts depend on original validation group sizes

selection_use: VQC architecture and training epoch selection
calibration_use: fit/choose fixed residual fusion scale and clip policy after all model weights are frozen
decide whether VQC residual is activated

pretest_activation_criterion.primary: selective VQC calibration MAE must be strictly lower than both frozen GBDT and frozen small classical residual control
pretest_activation_criterion.guardrail: selective VQC calibration RMSE must be no worse than either comparator
pretest_activation_criterion.failure_action: set operational VQC alpha to zero; keep trained VQC as experimental only
pretest_activation_criterion.evidence_qualification: calibration rows are used to select the fusion policy; this comparison is calibration evidence, not an unbiased final estimate

sealed_test.evaluation_stage: one independent metric evaluation after model weights, dependencies, preprocessing, fusion policy, and release manifest are frozen
